999008199.text: 戻ったのだな、鬼門！　永遠！

鏑矢様！
鬼門、永遠、ただいま帰還いたしました！

localizations.en: Lady Kaburaya! Kimon and Towa have returned!

999008199.text:
久方ぶりだな、鏑矢。
俺に会えなくて寂しくなかったか？

localizations.en: It's been a while, Kaburaya. Weren't you lonely without me around?

999008199.text:
笑止！　千歳がそばにいてくれたのだ、
まったく寂しくなどなかったぞ

localizations.en: Ridiculous! Chitose has been by my side, so I wasn't lonely in the slightest.

999008199.text: なあ？　千歳

ふふ……鏑矢様、
本日もお勤め、お疲れさまでした

localizations.en: Hehe... Lady Kaburaya, thank you for your hard work today.

999008199.text:
ああ、此度の視察対応も実に疲れた！
千歳の淹れた茶が飲みたい

localizations.en: Ah, this inspection business was truly exhausting! I'd love some of your tea, Chitose.

999008199.text: はい、鏑矢様が望むなら、何杯でも……

localizations.en: Of course, Lady Kaburaya. If that's what you wish, I'll brew as many cups as you'd like...

999008199.text: まったく、相変わらず千歳は鏑矢に甘いなぁ

localizations.en: Honestly, you still spoil Kaburaya as much as ever, Chitose.

999008199.text:
さて。此度の任務、誠にご苦労であった！
堂免領当主として労おう

localizations.en: Now then. You've both worked hard on this mission! As lady of the Doumen domain, I commend you.

999008199.text:
ありがたき幸せでございます。
調査の結果ですが――

localizations.en: We are most grateful for your praise. Regarding the results of our investigation—

999008199.text:
調査の結果は、中で聞こう。
千歳の茶を飲みながらな！

localizations.en: Let's hear your report inside, over some of Chitose's tea!

999008199.text:
ああ、それはぜひご一緒したいところだが、
報告は鬼門に任せてもいいかい？

localizations.en: Ah, I'd love to join you, but would it be all right if I left the report to Kimon?

999008199.text:
どうかしたでござるか？
何か予定が？

localizations.en: Is something the matter? Do you have other plans?

999008199.text:
いやなに、陰陽師の修行やクロガネ島での魔物退治に
ついて、実家に報告しようと思ってね

localizations.en: Nothing urgent. I just want to report back to my family about my diviner training and the demon extermination on Kurogane Island.

999008199.text:
それに、ここで鏑矢と千歳の顔も見れたからね。
俺は先にお暇させてもらうよ

localizations.en: Besides, I got to see both you and Chitose. I'll head out first.

999008199.text: そういうことなら、承知したでござる

localizations.en: If that's the case, I understand.

999008199.text:
永遠！　明日、また城へ来るといい！
久方ぶりに、共に稽古をしよう

localizations.en: Towa! Return to the castle tomorrow! It's been too long since we've trained together.

999008199.text:
ああ、分かった。
千歳のお茶も、また今度飲ませてくれよ

localizations.en: Sure thing. And let me have some of Chitose's tea next time too.

999008199.text: は、はい、分かりました

ケイウン南部を統治する堂免家の若き当主。
刀の達人で、幼い頃より数々の武勇伝がある

localizations.en: The young lady of the Doumen family, who governs southern Keiun. A master swordswoman with countless tales of valor from her youth.
